parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The bandwidth of the Express Connect circuit. Unit: Mbit/s.

Valid values: **2** to **10240**.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. 

The client generates the value. Ensure that the value is unique among different requests. 

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request.

parameters.name: CompanyName
parameters.description: The name of the company that accesses the Express Connect circuit.

parameters.name: ConstructionTime
parameters.description: The time when the construction company enters the site. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and must be in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Express Connect circuit.

parameters.name: LineType
parameters.description:
The type of the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

- **MSTP**
- **MPLSVPN**
- **FIBRE**
- **Other**

parameters.name: PMInfo
parameters.description: The information about the construction engineers.

sub_parameters.name: PMCertificateNo
sub_parameters.description:
The ID number of the construction engineer. You can specify an ID card number or a passport number.

You can configure information for up to 16 construction engineers.

sub_parameters.name: PMCertificateType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the ID document of the construction engineer. Valid values:

- **IDCard**: ID card.
- **Passport**: passport.

sub_parameters.name: PMContactInfo
sub_parameters.description: The contact information of the construction engineer.

sub_parameters.name: PMGender
sub_parameters.description: The gender of the construction engineer.

sub_parameters.name: PMName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the construction engineer.

parameters.name: PeerLocation
parameters.description: The geographical location where the Express Connect circuit is deployed.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the Express Connect circuit is deployed. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: Si
parameters.description: The construction company of the Express Connect circuit.
